observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera body with a telephoto zoom lens attached, resting on a McSteve Gadget Store box. "Nikon" is visible on the top right of the body.
Photo 1 shows the camera from the rear/top; the lens barrel reads "Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 70-300mm 1:4.5-6.3G ED VR". The camera body has no top LCD panel.
Photo 2 shows the left side/top of the camera; "Nikon" is visible on the pentaprism. The grip area shows scuffing/wear. The lens front ring is visible but the body model text is not legible.
